payload.title: IPC design v3 delta — pipe hardening, write-ahead intent, single critical section, observed identity

delta_1_pipe_boundary.correction_accepted: Not enabling SMB sharing proves nothing about remote pipe reachability. Withdrawing the v2 access-boundary claim.
delta_1_pipe_boundary.pipe_creation: CreateNamedPipe with PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS (0x08) — remote clients are rejected at the pipe level regardless of SMB state. This is explicit, not default.
delta_1_pipe_boundary.access_policy: Explicit DACL, least privilege: grant GENERIC_READ|GENERIC_WRITE on the pipe to exactly one SID (the owner-process user), deny all others. No reliance on the default security descriptor.
delta_1_pipe_boundary.api_surface: pywin32 (win32pipe.CreateNamedPipe + win32security.SetSecurityDescriptorDacl), NOT multiprocessing connections — multiprocessing does not expose PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS or DACL control, and its recv() unpickles.
delta_1_pipe_boundary.verification: GetNamedPipeInfo confirms PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS is set; GetSecurityInfo on the pipe handle returns the actual DACL for audit. A remote connection attempt must fail; a wrong-user local attempt must get access denied. Both are activation-gate checks, documented here as the acceptance criteria.

delta_2_write_ahead_intent.correction_accepted: Intent must be durable before the backend fires, outcome durable after. Withdrawing any implication that journaling leases alone suffices.
dispatch_sequence: 1-6. All v2 checks (caller, task scope, target binding, payload bounds, approval, exclusive ownership) — unchanged.

7. Write INTENT record to journal and fsync. Record: caller handle, task, target, payload hash, approval ref, budget reservation. If this write fails: zero dispatch, client refused. No backend call happens.
9. Write OUTCOME record to journal and fsync. If this write fails: the uncertainty barrier holds — intent exists with no outcome, route is uncertain.
10. Release lock, return outcome to client.
delta_2_write_ahead_intent.crash_semantics: Intent with no outcome after restart = uncertain, never replayed. Replay requires independent quiescence evidence through the reconciliation path, not the dispatch path. A failed intent write means the action never happened; a failed outcome write means it happened but is unverified.
delta_2_write_ahead_intent.journal_events_extended: leases, admissions, revocations, uncertainty-holds, quiescence-evidence, PLUS: intent, outcome. Action records are first-class journal events.

delta_3_single_critical_section.correction_accepted: A final dictionary recheck is not proof of no gap. Withdrawing the v2 TOCTOU mitigation.
delta_3_single_critical_section.the_lock: One lock: the existing threading lock from the reviewed route_owner_v7 contract. Reused, not duplicated, not supplemented.
delta_3_single_critical_section.held_across: Caller/revocation check, lease + expiry check, approval/budget validation AND reservation, intent journal write + fsync, backend invocation, outcome journal write + fsync. The lock is held continuously from first check through outcome persistence.
delta_3_single_critical_section.serialized_against_dispatch: Lease transfer, revocation, and setup reconciliation acquire the SAME lock. They cannot interleave with dispatch — they queue behind it or precede it atomically. There is no gap because there is no unlock between check and effect.
delta_3_single_critical_section.why_this_is_stronger: v2 checked, released, re-checked. v3 never releases. The recheck is unnecessary because the state cannot change under the holder.

delta_4_observed_identity.correction_accepted: Hostname/username matching proves nothing about pipe access or shared-owner reachability. Withdrawing the v2 identity-comparison-via-names approach.
delta_4_observed_identity.observed_not_deduced: At pipe connection time, the server calls GetNamedPipeClientProcessId, opens the client process, and reads its token: user SID and session ID. These are observed Windows security facts, not name comparisons.
delta_4_observed_identity.what_is_compared: Client user SID == owner user SID (same account, not same username string). Client session ID recorded for the desktop-session question. Caller handle still presented per-request, but now bound to the observed SID at connect time — a handle presented over a connection whose SID doesn't match the registered SID is refused.
delta_4_observed_identity.reporting: Public packets report match/difference conclusions only. SIDs, usernames, hostnames, and session IDs stay in the private channel or local logs, never in public repo packets.
delta_4_observed_identity.remains_observed_later: Actual pipe access and shared-owner reachability are confirmed by successful authenticated connection + status round-trip at activation, not deduced now.

transport_frames.framing: Length-prefixed byte frames: 4-byte big-endian length, max 1,000,000 bytes (matches the queue's existing cap), then the payload.
transport_frames.parsing: Strict schema validation on canonical JSON v1 (integers only) BEFORE any dispatch logic touches the content. Malformed frames are dropped and logged, never partially processed.
transport_frames.no_pickle: Raw win32file.ReadFile/WriteFile on the pipe handle with manual framing. Python multiprocessing connections are explicitly excluded: recv() unpickles, which is a deserialization boundary we do not accept.

acceptance_cases: intent_write_failure: journal write fails (simulated) -> zero backend effects, client refused, no intent record.
crash_after_intent: process dies between intent fsync and outcome -> restart loads intent-without-outcome as uncertain; no replay without quiescence evidence.
two_concurrent_one_action: two threads dispatch simultaneously -> exactly one backend effect; the loser is refused or queued, never double-executed.
expiry_race: lease expires mid-dispatch-sequence -> expiry path acquires the same lock, serialized; dispatch either completed wholly before expiry or is refused.
revocation_race: caller revoked mid-dispatch -> same lock serialization; in-flight dispatch completes or is fenced, never half-applied.
journal_failure_vs_clean_stop: disk-full/corrupt journal -> fail closed, owner refuses new work; clean stop -> orderly drain, unresolved effects journaled as uncertain.
payload.scope_restated: Design delta only. No listener, no pipe creation, no DACL changes, no live backend calls, no GUI input. The v2 transport selection (named pipes) and owner contract stand; this delta hardens them.
